verdict.rationale: Remote documents creating employees through the API via `POST /v1/employments`, with country-specific dynamic JSON schemas and a type-dependent onboarding flow. It also claims you can push contracts and payroll inputs, and a sandbox token supports agent testing. Compensation and tax setup are not explicitly documented, and the MCP write tools cover only employee self-service, not hiring. missing for 10: explicit compensation and tax-setup endpoints or fields, documentation of the full end-to-end onboarding sequence, agent-facing (MCP/skill) onboarding write tools, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent onboard a new hire end-to-end via the API — creating the employee, compensation, and tax setup

citations.quote: All employment types are created through the same endpoint — `POST /v1/employments` — but the required fields and onboarding flow differ depending on the `type` you specify.
Remote uses **dynamic JSON schemas** to define which fields are required for each country.
push people, contracts, and payroll inputs into Remote
